ev.q: The Task Force reported a total of 22 cases of Ebola in Mawah during September 9–October 2, of which 19 were fatal.
During October 3–November 21, no new cases were reported in the village.
An investigation by the Task Force identified 22 incident cases of Ebola (13 confirmed and nine probable) in Mawah
Seven of the patients were female, and the median age was 44 years.
A total of 160 contacts were identified.
